name: GitHub secret scanning alert to Teams Adaptive Card (Preview)
description:
## What it does

Receives an already-authenticated GitHub `secret_scanning_alert` delivery and renders only allowlisted alert metadata as an Adaptive Card using **Webhook → Code → DevX Message Connector**. The formatter excludes the secret value, comments, provider metadata, and original request body.

## Setup

1. Add a **DevX Message Connector** credential containing the full Teams channel link and configure `DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_URL` and `DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_KEY`.
2. Use a trusted receiver to validate `X-Hub-Signature-256` against the original request bytes before forwarding to this workflow. Attach **Header Auth** for authenticated forwarding and preserve the GitHub event and delivery headers.
3. While editing, POST a redacted sample to `/webhook-test/devx/github-secret-scanning-alert` and inspect the Preview response. Activate the workflow before using `/webhook/devx/github-secret-scanning-alert`, and change **Mode** to **Send** only after reviewing the card.

## Notes

The Code node is not a signature verifier. Execution-data saving is disabled; restrict workflow and Teams-channel access and review platform audit/error logging before enabling real deliveries. Preview calls `<DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_URL>/api/v1/messages/preview` without posting to Teams; it is not an offline transformation mode. The Webhook responds immediately, so acceptance does not confirm Teams delivery. The Code node is the exact script from the [source runbook](https://bcgov.github.io/common-hosted-workflow/operations/github-secret-scanning-alert-notifications). No credentials or pinned execution data are included.
